item.title: DataFluss 1.3.1
item.description:
DataFluss 1.3.1

  • New icon: two tables with arrows between them, for what DataFluss does: your data on this computer and on the server, kept in step in both directions.
  • The web app has the new icon too, in the browser tab and when installed.
  • Nothing else changes, and the database stays the same: computers keep syncing with servers on 1.3.0.
